explanation: Their times follow the Sun, from dawn to night, so clock times shift through the year. Worshippers face the Kaaba in Mecca, a direction called the qibla.

claims.text: Islam prescribes five daily prayers (salat) for adult Muslims.
The number of obligatory daily prayers is not two, four or seven.
The times of the daily prayers are set by the position of the Sun, from dawn to night, so their clock times change through the year.
Muslims pray facing the Kaaba in Mecca, a direction called the qibla.
